maddeler.e:
نحمار (form XI)
# نَحْمَارُّ (naḥmārru) /naħ.maːr.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْمَارَّ (iḥmārra)
# نَحْمَارَّ (naḥmārra) /naħ.maːr.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْمَارَّ (iḥmārra)
# نَحْمَارِّ (naḥmārri) /naħ.maːr.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْمَارَّ (iḥmārra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
